# Gallery

Every image the skill can put in a README, as real links that pass `check_images.py`. The star and fork numbers in the first strip come from this repo. The star chart uses the HyperWeave repo because this one does not have enough stars to draw a line.

## Strips, badges, icons, cards, charts

Live GitHub data. Use it only when the repo has a real git remote and is public. A value that cannot be fetched shows `-`, never an invented number.

<img alt="Live strip for BankReadme: stars and forks" src="https://hyperweave.app/v1/strip/BankReadme/brutalist.static?data=gh%3Akoravut-Dev%2FBankReadme.stars%2Cgh%3Akoravut-Dev%2FBankReadme.forks&variant=celadon" width="560">

Status badge. Use it only when the repo has CI.

<img alt="Status badge: CHECKS passing" src="https://hyperweave.app/v1/badge/CHECKS/passing/primer.static?state=passing&variant=porcelain" width="200">

Icons for tools in the stack.

<img alt="Python icon, circle" src="https://hyperweave.app/v1/icon/python/primer.static?shape=circle&variant=noir" width="64"> <img alt="GitHub icon, square" src="https://hyperweave.app/v1/icon/github/primer.static?shape=square&variant=porcelain" width="64">

Profile card, for a person's profile README.

<img alt="GitHub profile card for koravut-Dev" src="https://hyperweave.app/v1/card/koravut-Dev/primer.static?variant=porcelain" width="480">

<img alt="Star history chart for InnerAura/hyperweave" src="https://hyperweave.app/v1/chart/stars/InnerAura/hyperweave/primer.static?variant=porcelain" width="560">

## Diagrams

Eight custom topologies and two presets. A preset shows sample content, so use a preset only for a generic picture. The other topologies in the catalog (`pipeline`, `fanout`, `dag`) appear in the README and in `references/hyperweave-catalog.md`, which also lists all 59 presets.

### cycle

a loop that repeats until it passes

<img alt="Diagram cycle: a loop that repeats until it passes" src="https://hyperweave.app/v1/diagram/custom/primer.static?variant=porcelain&face=light&" width="560">
